command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: build local repo from local storage =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/localrepo
sudo -n cp /tmp/localrepo/tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm /srv/localrepo/
sudo -n createrepo_c /srv/localrepo
ls -la /srv/localrepo/repodata | head

echo "== STEP 2: serve repo over HTTP on NODE_IP =="
cat <<'PYEOF' | sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/localrepo-http.service >/dev/null
[Unit]
Description=Local package repository HTTP server
After=network.target

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/srv/localrepo
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
PYEOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now localrepo-http.service
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active localrepo-http.service
curl -sS -m 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/repodata/repomd.xml" -o /tmp/repomd_check.xml
grep -c '<data' /tmp/repomd_check.xml

echo "== STEP 3: open firewall for 8080 if firewalld active =="
if sudo -n systemctl is-active firewalld >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp --permanent
  sudo -n firewall-cmd --reload
  echo "firewalld opened 8080"
else
  echo "firewalld not active, skipping"
fi

echo "== STEP 4: register local repo with dnf =="
cat <<EOF | sudo -n tee /etc/yum.repos.d/localrepo.repo >/dev/null
[localrepo]
name=Local Package Repository
baseurl=http://$NODE_IP:8080/
enabled=1
gpgcheck=0
EOF

echo "== STEP 5: capture baseline - remote repos currently reachable =="
sudo -n dnf -v repolist 2>&1 | grep -E 'Repo-id|Repo-baseurl'

echo "== DONE =="
